text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm waiting for my train<n>on the station
platform...

...And just like that, the time has<n>come for us to part
ways.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We met for the first time exactly one<n>year ago.
Each day we spent<n>together is an irreplaceable
memory<n>to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl looks devastated<n>while saying
farewell to someone...<n>except I don't see anyone
else<n>nearby.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm bidding farewell to the seasonal<n>bento boxes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today is the last day they'll be on<n>sale. The next
time we'll meet won't<n>be until next year, which
why I must<n>do this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, shopkeeper! May I have<n>twelve of
these bentos?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to fill my heart and stomach<n>with enough
food for the months we<n>can't meet!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So what you're trying to say is that if<n>I wish to
preserve this memory, I<n>should focus not on how
much I eat,<n>but rather the heart and quality of my
experience.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have one, then, so I can<n>focus all my time
and attention talking<n>with it face-to-face.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Chomp... Thank you simmered meat!Munch... Au revoir, white fish!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This I declare—not a single sesame<n>seed nor grain
of rice will be left<n>uneaten!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Chomp, munch... Urgh... Don't give up,stomach! This is the last time we'llsee these lovely morsels for a while!
